page.intro: Configure the email service and manage each user's notification preferences.
settings.fromEmail.help: Must be on your verified Resend sending domain.
settings.publicUrl.help: Used to build poster images, deep links and the unsubscribe link in emails. Leave blank to attach posters instead.
settings.publicUrl.warnNone: Without a public URL, emails carry no unsubscribe link or header.
settings.publicUrl.warnHttp: This URL is not https: mail clients will not show their one-click unsubscribe button. The footer link still works.
settings.cap.help: From 1 to 200. Beyond that, the newsletter ends each section with "and N more".
settings.quotaDaily.help: Your Resend plan's daily quota (100 on the free plan). 0 if your plan has no daily limit.
settings.quotaMonthly.help: Your Resend plan's monthly quota (3000 on the free plan).
settings.alertEmail.help: At most one digest a day when something went wrong (failed sends, quota, campaign error, bounce, lost data). Leave empty to rely on the banner of this page only.
settings.injectWebUi: Add the notification settings to Jellyfin Web
settings.injectWebUi.help: Turn off if a Jellyfin Web update breaks the page. Users then manage their emails from the unsubscribe links only.
settings.injectSeriesBell: Show the follow bell on series pages
settings.inviteWithoutEmail: Invite users without a contact email
settings.inviteWithoutEmail.help: A banner on the home page, until the user closes it. Takes effect after Jellyfin restarts.
settings.secretSet: A value is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
pref.intro: Each user chooses what they receive from their own settings. You can override it here. A user with no contact address is skipped at send time.
pref.readOnly.help: Announcements, new episodes and followed series are set by each user from their own settings.
common.saveError: Could not save. Check the values and try again.
status.warn: You have used 80 percent of a sending limit.
status.reserve: {n} of today's sends are kept for a campaign due today: series emails stop at {max}.
status.suspended: Resend refused a send for quota: sending is paused until {date} UTC.
status.orphanedSeries: {n} subscription(s) to series no longer found in the library (removed or re-created under a new id).
status.banner: {n} incident(s) in the last 24 hours. Open the Status tab.
status.alertOff: Incident alerts: no address set, the banner of this page only.
status.alertNone: Incident alerts: no digest sent yet.
status.alertLast: Incident alerts: last digest sent on {date} UTC.
status.help.transport: Connection to Resend and sending quota.
status.kv.ftOff: Missing: the user settings panel is not injected
status.help.campaigns: Next run and last send of each scheduled campaign.
status.help.drains: Since the server started. Any value other than 0 in Lost or Dropped points to a problem.
status.noIncidents: No incident in the last 7 days.
status.help.recent: The latest emails, with masked addresses.
incident.quota.threshold: 80 percent of a sending limit reached
manual.intro: Write a one-off email. All users: everyone with a contact address, except users who turned off announcements. Selected users: the users you tick, even if they turned off announcements.
manual.subject: Subject
manual.progress: Sending: {processed} / {total}. You can close this page, the send carries on.
manual.error.progress: Could not follow the send. It carries on on the server; check the send log.
manual.error.subject: A subject is required.
manual.error.send: Could not send. Check the transport settings and try again.
manual.error.script: The HTML body must not contain a script.
manual.error.sendAt: Choose a send date and time.
manual.error.scheduleAttachments: A scheduled announcement cannot have attachments.
manual.schedule.title: Schedule the send
manual.schedule.timeZone: Time zone: {tz}. The send goes out within 15 minutes of the chosen time.
manual.schedule.error.past: The send date must be in the future.
manual.schedule.error.tooFar: The send date must be less than a year away.
manual.schedule.error.generic: Could not schedule. Check the message and try again.
manual.schedule.error.cancel: Could not cancel: the announcement may already have gone out.
manual.wrap: Lay out with the Easy Notif template
logs.intro: The plugin's own dedicated log file. Refresh to load the latest lines.
logs.level.label: Level
campaigns.intro: The two scheduled campaigns. Enable one, set its recurrence and mail language, or run it now. Recipients are the users opted in to the matching category.
campaigns.pauseNextRun: Send nothing on the next scheduled run
campaigns.previewSentRecap: Preview sent, filled with your own viewing.
campaigns.error.noContactEmail: Set your contact address in your notification preferences first.
campaigns.error.dayOfWeek: Choose a day of the week.
campaigns.error.dayOfMonth: Enter a day of month between 1 and 31.
campaigns.error.intervalDays: Enter an interval of at least 1 day.
templates.intro: The base templates are read-only. Clone one to make an editable copy, then point a campaign at it from the Campaigns tab.
templates.clone.prompt: Name for the new template (letters, digits and hyphens):
templates.base.readonly: This is a base template and cannot be edited. Clone it to make changes.
templates.base.fixed: This template is used for the new-episode emails. It is read-only and cannot be cloned.
templates.base.generic: This template lays out the manual emails. It is read-only and cannot be cloned.
templates.error.script: A script tag is not allowed in a template.
templates.error.tooLarge: This template is too large (max 64 KB).
templates.error.clone: Could not clone. Check the name and try again.
templates.error.inUse: This template is still used by the campaign {campaign}. Point that campaign at another template first.
